owner: LLD-03 supplies ticket/domain state; LLD-10 owns frontend implementation and deliberate-interaction mechanics
states: pending RFC terminal cascade awaiting explicit deliberate confirmation
stale RFC terminal cascade requiring refreshed impact scope
RFC local archived presentation distinct from source terminal state
archive-operation history and operation-scoped restore eligibility
RFC hard-delete eligible preview or typed blockers
rules: UI working copy never mutates ticket/domain state until command commit.
SR RFC tab renders direct roots with nested subordinate/WFM branches; it never fabricates subordinate direct SR links.
RFC Service Requests and Devices tab may originate a link action from a subordinate, but preview resolves the governing root and preserves subordinate-origin provenance.
RFC Related RFCs list virtualizes/keyset-pages large child sets; no 20-child product limit is presented.
Device Reference view shows current operational identity first; optional Network Element resolution is secondary derived context.
Three-second Device Reference promotion belongs to LLD-10/LLD-08 interaction/Infrastructure command and never changes the ticket relationship target.
Notes edits/removals are explicit commands with stale-revision handling; source import cannot produce note edit controls.
Archived RFC remains accessible/history-visible and can still receive exact source reconciliation; archive is not presented as provider cancellation/completion.
Accepted terminal RFC source evidence updates terminal presentation and shows the persisted pending cascade, but does not present Task/Objective/Communication consequences as already executed.
Terminal cascade impact shows exact captured RFC/WFM members, current-vs-captured stale differences and participant consequence summaries before confirmation.

Cascade execution uses the governed three-second deliberate hold or accepted accessible equivalent from LLD-10; backend execution requires session-bound proof for the exact proposal revision/fingerprint rather than trusting a client boolean.

Branch archive preview distinguishes members that will change from RFCs already archived; restore is presented from the originating archive operation so unrelated archived RFCs cannot be activated accidentally.
RFC hard delete is never a generic Delete button: the UI first shows exact eligibility/blockers and only exposes explicit confirmed hard-delete action for a still-eligible untouched manual draft.
preview_contracts: Hierarchy/link previews show immutable IDs/business IDs, current revisions, exact proposed relation changes, Customer mismatch/unresolved state, and downstream warnings without merging identities.

Terminal cascade preview compares immutable captured proposal scope with current hierarchy/WFM membership and separately previews Task/Objective and Communication consequences; preview cannot execute or refresh.
Archive preview binds exact member revisions/archive states to a scope fingerprint; operation restore shows only members still owned by that operation.
Hard-delete preview is advisory and bound to revision/provider freshness/eligibility fingerprint; commit reruns all guards.
Every preview is advisory; commit reruns authoritative checks and returns stale conflict when changed.
